An ordered list displays items in a sequence, usually with numbers, and is created with <ol>. An unordered list displays items with bullets and is created with <ul>. In both lists, each item is enclosed in an <li> tag.
Use link text. The href attribute specifies the destination, and the text between the opening and closing tags is clickable.
The <table> tag creates a table for displaying data in rows and columns. The <tr> tag defines a row, <th> defines a heading cell, and <td> defines a data cell.
